cohort: The study included 382 pregnant women giving birth in the hospital, comprising an Omicron group (136 cases) and a non-Omicron group (246 cases).
finding: Omicron infection was associated with longer hospitalization time, increased 2-hour postpartum hemorrhage volume, and a higher neonatal-pediatric transfer rate.
followup_time: Until maternal and neonatal hospital discharge or transfer for neonates, with specific observations at 2 hours postpartum.
